feat(context): restore retained native tool exchanges

Recover the unpublished native-history implementation from the exact PR payload and revalidate it with the supplied Go 1.27.1 toolchain. Retained exchanges remain non-executable, reuse existing ReAct renderers, preserve complete call/result pairing and exact numeric IDs, and exclude prior history from completion-hook ingestion. Window v2 reads legacy windows as inert evidence; journal version remains independent.

All 13 focused package race suites passed on this recovered source, including real pinned Bifrost OpenAI/Anthropic scripted HTTP paths, SQLite restoration and shared-Stack isolation. No claim of full CI/preflight, provider proficiency or RC readiness. Interrupted-prefix reconciliation, checkpoint reuse and large-result/catalog recovery remain outstanding.
